exam_scheme.note: The AIIMS B.Sc (Hons) Nursing Entrance Examination is conducted annually by the Examination Section, All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), New Delhi, for admission to the undergraduate 4-year B.Sc (Honours) Nursing programme offered across all participating AIIMS institutes nationwide (including AIIMS New Delhi, Bhopal, Bhubaneswar, Jodhpur, Patna, Raipur, Rishikesh, Kalyani, Deoghar, Gorakhpur, Bathinda, Bibinagar, Bilaspur, Jammu, Guwahati, and Rajkot). The test is administered as a single-shift Computer Based Test (CBT) of 120 minutes (2 hours) duration comprising 100 objective-type multiple choice questions. Admission is strictly based on merit obtained in the entrance test through centralized online seat allocation.
